description: Per tracked prompt: how often AI names the member's brand, how often it's recommended, the leading tracked competitor, which brands AI names instead in the answers that leave the member out (including brands they don't track yet), and change vs the previous period. Sorted to show the prompts you're losing first. Use for "which questions don't mention us?", "who wins the questions we're missing?" or "where is a competitor leading?". Needs sign-in to Kliqo (read-only).
